content: विबुध् €1 <ab>P.</ab> €4 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To wake up, awake; निमील्य नेत्रे सहसा व्यबुध्यत <ls>Ku. 5. 57</ls>. .²2 To become conscious. .²3 To observe, perceive; find out. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To awaken, rouse. .²2 To restore to consciousness; अथ मोहपरायणा सती विवशा कामवधूर्विवोधिता <ls>Ku. 4. 1</ls>.
